subject: Reference matchmaking for Agrivista APAC supply-chain pilot
messages:
From: Priya Menon <priya@agrivista.co>
To: aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-11-20 03:12 +08:00
Subject: Reference request — APAC supply-chain pilot (late-stage)

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. We are in the final procurement phase for a pilot focused on real-time anomaly detection across our grain distribution yards in India and Indonesia. Procurement has asked for 2–3 references who have run similar on-prem or VPC-deployed inference workloads in APAC (ideally with intermittent connectivity and on-prem key management).

Scope: small pilot (3 sites) with potential expansion to 50+ sites if results are good. Timeline: contract signature targeted mid-December. Pricing/SLAs will be negotiated, but the execs want to speak to peers about latency, rollout friction, and operational support (SOC / audit logs).

Attached is our RFP extract with the key requirements. Can Redwood provide customer references (preferably agritech or supply-chain companies in APAC) and a short intro call this week? If helpful, K. Singh (cc) is our procurement lead.

Thanks,
Priya Menon
Head of Technology, Agrivista
[Attachment: Agrivista_RFP_SupplyChain_2027.pdf (pdf)]

From: aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-11-20 04:05 +08:00
Subject: Fwd: Reference request — APAC supply-chain pilot (late-stage)

Marissa, Vivek — forwarding Agrivista's ask. Late-stage deal, likely decision by mid-Dec. They need APAC on-prem/VPC references that have dealt with spotty connectivity and on-prem KMS.

Quick asks:
- Marissa: do we have any agritech or rural logistics references (APAC) comfortable speaking about a pilot?
- Vivek: any redlines on SOW / SLA we should proactively surface to procurement?

I can intro on a short call once we have the reference names.

Thanks,
Aisha
Account Exec — Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-11-20 07:18 +08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Reference request — APAC supply-chain pilot (late-stage)

Aisha — we have a good match. FarmNet (India) ran a similar pilot earlier this year with our private deployment (VPC w/ customer-managed KMS) for edge inference across 5 depots.

Contacts:
- Raghav Iyer, Head of Ops, FarmNet (raghav.iyer@farmnet.in) — spoke to latency tuning, KV cache for intermittent networks, and go/no-go criteria.
- Anu Patel, CTO, FarmNet (anu.patel@farmnet.in) — comfortable discussing procurement/SOC and onboarding timeline.

I attached a sanitized SOW example and the notes from their post-pilot review (redacted). FarmNet is open to a 30-minute peer call; I can make the intros and moderate.

On contract posture — Vivek, heads-up: Agrivista calls out on-prem KMS and audit logs. Recommend we offer the dedicated VPC option with explicit audit-log retention and a 99.5% inference availability SLA for the pilot, with expansion SLAs negotiable. Also prepare a short onboarding checklist (networking, certs, initial KV cache seed).

Attachments: Marissa_FarmNet_SOW_sample.pdf

—Marissa
Director, Customer Advocacy

From: aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com
To: Priya Menon <priya@agrivista.co>, K. Singh <ksingh@agrivista.co>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-11-20 09:42 +08:00
Subject: Re: Reference request — APAC supply-chain pilot (late-stage)

Hi Priya / K.,

Thanks for the RFP excerpt. I wanted to introduce Marissa Cole from our Customer Advocacy team — she coordinated the FarmNet pilot that maps closely to your requirements and can speak to the on-prem/VPC setup, KMS integration, and ops runbook.

Marissa — meet Priya Menon (Agrivista Head of Technology) and K. Singh (procurement). Priya mentioned availability this week for a short peer call. Would either of the following windows work for an introduction (30 minutes)?
- Tue 2027-11-21 10:00–10:30 IST / 13:30–14:00 SGT
- Wed 2027-11-22 15:00–15:30 SGT / 12:30–13:00 IST

We can keep it focused: rollout steps, connectivity mitigations, KMS/audit experience, and pilot success metrics. If you prefer, I can also share the FarmNet SOW and the sanitized post-pilot notes ahead of time (attached).

Best,
Aisha
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Marissa_FarmNet_SOW_sample.pdf (pdf)]

Hi Aisha / Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround and the SOW. Tue 21 Nov at 10:00 IST works for us. I’ve invited our procurement counsel as well.

Looking forward to the call — if you could share a one-pager summary of the FarmNet outcomes (latency numbers, uptime during intermittent connectivity, and any operational blockers), that would be very helpful ahead of the meeting.

Cheers,
Priya
